title: Protocol security unit test fails: device ACL accepts requests without a master token
summary: test_protocol_security case 'device ACL requires device or nonzero master token' fails deterministically (unit/test_protocol_security.c:537) with the current build/lib/libindigo.a, also when built against the committed indigo_names.h; unrelated to the scheduler task. Next: determine whether libindigo is stale or the bus ACL check regressed, then fix and rerun make -C indigo_test test-unit.
